title: 2-Slice Toaster with Wide Slots, 7 Browning Levels and Crumb Tray
description:
Compact toaster for everyday breakfasts, with extra-wide slots that take thick bread, bagels and brioche.
• 850 W, 7 browning levels with defrost, reheat and cancel buttons
• 3.8 cm wide slots with self-centring bread guides
• Brushed stainless steel housing
• Pull-out crumb tray, cord storage and EU plug

title: Mini Oven 12 L with Timer, Top and Bottom Heat, Tray and Rack
description:
Small countertop oven for toast, pizza slices, muffins and reheating leftovers without heating up a full-size oven.
• Capacity 12 L, 1000 W, temperature 100–230 °C
• 60-minute timer with bell; top, bottom or combined heating
• Includes baking tray, wire rack and tray handle
• Retro-style housing with glass door; EU plug

title: Hand Mixer 300 W with 5 Speeds, Turbo Button and 4 Attachments
description:
Lightweight hand mixer for whipping cream, beating egg whites and mixing cake batter or soft bread dough.
• 300 W motor with 5 speeds plus turbo boost
• Includes 2 stainless steel beaters and 2 dough hooks
• One-touch eject button for removing attachments
• 1.2 m cable with EU plug; weighs about 1 kg

title: Retro Electric Kettle 1.7 L with Temperature Gauge
description:
Retro-style kettle with a built-in temperature gauge, so you can see when the water is right for green tea, coffee or a full boil.
• Capacity 1.7 L, 2200 W fast boil
• Stainless steel body with enamel finish and analogue temperature dial
• Automatic shut-off, boil-dry protection and removable limescale filter
• 360° cordless base with EU plug

title: Espresso Machine 20 Bar with Steam Wand and 1.5 L Water Tank
description:
Semi-automatic espresso machine for café-style espresso, cappuccino and latte at home.
• 20-bar pump and 1350 W fast-heating system
• Steam wand for frothing milk; removable 1.5 L water tank
• Portafilter with single and double baskets, measuring scoop and tamper
• Stainless steel front and removable drip tray; EU plug

title: Stovetop Espresso Maker 6 Cups, Aluminium
description:
Classic stovetop coffee maker that brews rich, strong coffee on gas, electric and ceramic hobs.
• Makes 6 small cups (300 ml)
• Food-grade aluminium body with heat-resistant handle
• Safety valve and replaceable silicone gasket
• Not suitable for induction hobs; hand wash only

title: Countertop Blender 1.5 L, 1200 W, with 6-Point Stainless Steel Blade
description:
Powerful blender for smoothies, crushed ice, soups and nut butters.
• 1200 W motor with 3 speeds, pulse and a smoothie programme
• 1.5 L BPA-free jug with measuring scale and vented lid
• 6-point stainless steel blade assembly
• Suction-cup feet, overload protection and EU plug

title: Hand Blender Set 800 W with Whisk, Chopper and Beaker
description:
Stick blender for puréeing soup right in the pot and for making sauces, baby food and milkshakes.
• 800 W motor, variable speed plus turbo button
• Stainless steel blending shaft with 4-blade cutter
• Includes whisk, 500 ml chopper bowl and 700 ml measuring beaker
• Detachable parts are dishwasher-safe; EU plug

title: Food Processor 2 L, 600 W, with Chopping Blade and Slicing Disc
description:
Compact food processor that chops onions, grates cheese, slices vegetables and mixes pastry in seconds.
• 600 W, 2 speeds plus pulse
• 2 L work bowl with feed tube and pusher
• Stainless steel S-blade, reversible slicing/shredding disc and dough blade
• Safety lock: runs only with the lid in place; EU plug

title: Digital Air Fryer 5.5 L with Touch Screen and 8 Presets
description:
Crispy fries, chicken wings and roast vegetables with little or no oil, cooked faster than in a conventional oven.
• Capacity 5.5 L, 1700 W, temperature 80–200 °C, 60-minute timer
• Touch display with 8 presets and a shake reminder
• Non-stick removable basket, dishwasher-safe
• Auto shut-off and cool-touch handle; EU plug

title: Compact Air Fryer 3.5 L with Dial Controls
description:
Space-saving air fryer for one or two people, ideal for small kitchens, student flats and caravans.
• Capacity 3.5 L, 1400 W, temperature 80–200 °C
• Simple dial controls with 30-minute timer
• Non-stick basket with safety release button
• Automatic shut-off; EU plug

title: Cordless Stick Vacuum 25 kPa with LED Display, Up to 40 Minutes
description:
Lightweight cordless vacuum that converts into a handheld for stairs, sofas and car seats.
• Suction up to 25 kPa, 3 power modes, up to 40 minutes runtime in eco mode
• LED display shows battery level and mode
• Washable multi-layer filter and 1.2 L dust cup
• Includes motorised floor brush, crevice tool, 2-in-1 brush, wall mount and charger with EU plug

title: Cordless Wet and Dry Floor Cleaner with Self-Cleaning Brush
description:
Vacuums and mops hard floors in one pass, picking up crumbs, spills and sticky marks.
• Separate clean-water (800 ml) and dirty-water (700 ml) tanks
• Rolling brush with a self-cleaning cycle in the charging base
• Runtime up to 35 minutes; LED display
• For tiles, laminate, vinyl and sealed wood; charging base with EU plug

title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner with App Control and Auto Recharge
description:
Robot vacuum that keeps floors tidy on a schedule and returns to its dock to recharge when the battery runs low.
• 2700 Pa suction, 3 power levels, runtime up to 120 minutes
• Control and scheduling via smartphone app or remote
• Low-profile body fits under most beds and sofas; anti-drop sensors for stairs
• Works on hard floors and low-pile carpets; charging dock with EU plug

title: Quartz Heater 1200 W with 3 Heating Rods and Tip-Over Switch
description:
Instant radiant heat for home offices, hobby rooms and workshops, warming you seconds after switching on.
• 3 quartz heating rods for 400, 800 or 1200 W
• Tip-over safety switch and protective front grille
• Carry handle and wall bracket included
• 1.5 m cable with EU plug

title: Rechargeable Desk Fan with 4 Speeds and Tilting Head
description:
Quiet cordless fan for desks, bedside tables and camping trips that keeps running without a socket nearby.
• 4 speeds and a 90° tilting head
• 4000 mAh battery for up to 12 hours on the lowest speed; USB-C charging
• Height-adjustable stem from 22 to 35 cm
• Weighted base that can also be wall-mounted

title: Hair Dryer 1800 W with Ionic Function and Magnetic Nozzle
description:
Compact, lightweight hair dryer that dries quickly and leaves hair smooth and shiny.
• 1800 W with 3 heat and 2 speed settings plus a cool-shot button
• Ionic function to reduce static and frizz
• Magnetic concentrator nozzle that clicks on in any direction
• 1.8 m cable with hanging loop and EU plug

title: Cordless Beard and Hair Trimmer with 4 Guide Combs
description:
Rechargeable trimmer for keeping beards, stubble and short hairstyles neat at home.
• Stainless steel blades, 20 length settings from 0.5 to 20 mm
• 4 guide combs, cleaning brush and blade oil included
• 600 mAh battery for 90 minutes of cordless use; USB charging
• Washable head and LED battery indicator

title: Steam Iron 2400 W with Ceramic Soleplate and Anti-Drip
description:
Powerful steam iron that glides easily over cotton, linen and blended fabrics.
• 2400 W, continuous steam 35 g/min and 160 g steam boost
• Ceramic soleplate; vertical steam for hanging garments
• 300 ml water tank with self-clean and anti-calc functions
• Anti-drip system, auto shut-off and 2 m cable with EU plug

title: Handheld Garment Steamer 1200 W, Ready in About 25 Seconds
description:
Removes creases from shirts, dresses and curtains without an ironing board, at home or when travelling.
• 1200 W, heats up in about 25 seconds
• Continuous steam up to 22 g/min; 200 ml removable water tank
• Works upright and horizontally
• Includes fabric brush and lint brush; EU plug

title: HEPA Air Purifier for Rooms up to 40 m², Quiet Sleep Mode
description:
A compact tower purifier that cleans the air in bedrooms, living rooms and home offices, quietly enough to leave on overnight.
• Three-stage filter: pre-filter, H13 HEPA filter and activated carbon for dust, pollen, pet hair and cooking odours
• Suitable for rooms up to 40 m²; 3 fan speeds plus an auto mode
• Sleep mode at 24 dB with the display lights switched off
• Filter-change reminder; replacement filters available separately; EU plug

title: Portable Blender 400 ml, USB-C Rechargeable, for Smoothies on the Go
description:
A cordless personal blender for smoothies, protein shakes and baby food, small enough for a gym bag or desk drawer.
• 400 ml BPA-free bottle that doubles as a drinking cup with a carry loop
• 6 stainless steel blades; blends frozen fruit and ice in about 30 seconds
• USB-C rechargeable: around 15 blends per charge
• Safety lock: runs only when the bottle is attached; rinse-clean in seconds
